title: Transaction detail ALDO CA/US 2025: aggregate profile
privacy: Aggregates only. Transaction numbers, consumer guids, site ids, postal codes, city names and image URLs are never read into any output.

conventions.sales_line: return_indicator falsy ('0'); units, retail, cost and margin are summed as given
conventions.return_line: return_indicator '1'; units, retail, cost and margin are negative in the file (see sign_patterns); the output reports return units and margin lost as positive numbers
conventions.gross_margin_rate: gross margin / retail on sales lines only (return lines excluded)
conventions.gross_margin_unit: dollars as given, banner currency assumed (ALDO_CA = CAD, ALDO_US = USD, unconfirmed)
conventions.gender: category prefix 'M ' = men's, 'L ' = ladies; anything else = other
conventions.footwear_rule: category matches '^[ML] (Cas|Dress|Perf) (Shoes|Boots|Sandals)$' or equals 'L Footwear'/'M Footwear'; everything else (handbags, jewelry, socks, sunglasses, belts, care products, insoles) is non-footwear. The full category-to-segment map is in each scope's categories block
conventions.fit_reasons: return_reason (strip, lower-case, whitespace collapse) equals 'too small' or 'too big', the same rule as fixtures/derived/fit_insights.json; 'trop grand' and comfort are not fit
conventions.numeric_reason_codes: Store (STR) return lines carry numeric POS reason codes. No legend exists in the project, so they are counted and never mapped to fit or preference
conventions.signal_rule: n_fit = too_small + too_big; below min_n insufficient_data; too_small/n_fit >= runs_small_min_share runs_small; <= runs_large_max_share runs_large; else mixed (exact fractions, as backend/returns_domain/fit.py)

M_footwear_styles_matched_to_oms_fit_ins.rule: men's footwear styles of this file with at least 500 units sold, matched by lower-cased name to fixtures/derived/fit_insights.json (OMS file, Feb 2024 to Jan 2026, all return channels); kept when OMS ALDO_CA n_fit >= 50 or OMS ALL n_fit >= 100
M_footwear_styles_matched_to_oms_fit_ins.caveat: A name match is not a key match: the OMS file has no category column for men's, so the match relies on the style name only (checked against ladies styles of this file in also_sold_as_ladies_footwear_in_this_file).

M_footwear_styles_matched_to_oms_fit_ins.caveat: A name match is not a key match: the OMS file has no category column for men's, so the match relies on the style name only (checked against ladies styles of this file in also_sold_as_ladies_footwear_in_this_file).

M_footwear_styles_matched_to_oms_fit_ins.caveat: A name match is not a key match: the OMS file has no category column for men's, so the match relies on the style name only (checked against ladies styles of this file in also_sold_as_ladies_footwear_in_this_file).

ALL.money_note: Money is not summed across banners (ALDO_CA assumed CAD, ALDO_US assumed USD, unconfirmed). Rates are unitless and indicative; counts and units are exact.
